candidates.old:
TYA
    SEC
    SBC rows_m1                     \ line - (rows left - 1)
    BCS last_cell                   \ 0 or more: it ends here
    EOR #&FF                        \ no: rows left after this cell, less 1: rows - line - 2
    STA rows_m1
.byte                               \ down to line 0
    LDA (d_ptr),Y                   \ the pixel/mask index
    TAX
    LDA (s_ptr),Y
    STA (v_ptr),Y                   \ saved
mask_operand = * + 1
    AND &FFFF,X                     \ self-modified: the mask table for the flip
pix_operand = * + 1
    EOR &FFFF,X                     \ self-modified: the pixel table for the colour and flip
    STA (s_ptr),Y
    DEY
    BPL byte
    LDA d_ptr                       \ the next cell: the data 8 back (C = 0 from the cell test:
    SBC #7                          \ the byte loop leaves C alone, so 7 + 1)...
    STA d_ptr
    BCS data_same_page
    DEC d_ptr + 1
    SEC                             \ C = 1 on both paths
candidates.new:
TYA
    SBC rows_m1                     \ line - (rows left - 1) (C = 1 already: the ADC #&FF above carried, col_ptr + 1 being 1 or more)
    BCS last_cell                   \ 0 or more: it ends here
    EOR #&FF                        \ no: rows left after this cell, less 1: rows - line - 2
    STA rows_m1
.byte                               \ down to line 0
    LDA (d_ptr),Y                   \ the pixel/mask index
    TAX
    LDA (s_ptr),Y
    STA (v_ptr),Y                   \ saved
mask_operand = * + 1
    AND &FFFF,X                     \ self-modified: the mask table for the flip
pix_operand = * + 1
    EOR &FFFF,X                     \ self-modified: the pixel table for the colour and flip
    STA (s_ptr),Y
    DEY
    BPL byte
    LDA d_ptr                       \ the next cell: the data 8 back (C = 0 from the cell test:
    SBC #7                          \ the byte loop leaves C alone, so 7 + 1)...
    STA d_ptr
    BCS data_same_page
    DEC d_ptr + 1
    SEC                             \ C = 1 on both paths
    NOP                             \ grind: pad for the SEC dropped above, so nothing after this slides (the cold path)
candidates.summary: Drop the SEC before the cell test (ADC #&FF on a sprite column address >= &0100 always leaves C = 1) and put the freed byte back as a NOP in the cold DEC d_ptr+1 path, so no later code moves. Alternative to the second candidate (same SEC removal); this one is byte-neutral.
candidates.equivalence: Only the SEC before SBC rows_m1 is removed. Entry to .cell is by fall-through only (grep: no other reference to draw_column.cell; draw_column is entered only at .each, from ren_draw_sprite). Just before, LDA col_ptr + 1 ; ADC #&FF ; STA d_ptr + 1: A = col_ptr + 1 >= 1, so A + &FF + C >= &100 and C = 1 whatever the carry in (col_ptr + 1 starts as straight_sprite_hi,X, tested non-zero by BNE known in ren_draw_sprite, and is only ever incremented by the column advance; the sprites are in ANDY at &8000-&8FFF). STA and TYA leave C, so SBC rows_m1 sees C = 1 exactly as after SEC: same A, same C, same Z/N, both exits (last_cell, the EOR/STA rows_m1 path) unchanged. SEC changed no register or other flag (V untouched either way). The NOP sits after the cold path's SEC, before .data_same_page; it changes no register or flag, and the hot path (BCS data_same_page taken) jumps over it.
candidates.relies_on: Relies on col_ptr + 1 >= 1 whenever draw_column reaches .cell (straight_sprite_hi non-zero, only incremented; sprites at &8000-&8FFF). Page crossings: none moved. The code from BCS last_cell to the SEC in the cold path moves down 1 byte inside page &9C (draw_column is &9B8F-&9CC8; .byte/BPL byte loop &9C33-&9C45 and .last_cell/.part_byte stay in page &9C, all branches here are same-page before and after: BCS last_cell, BPL byte, BCS data_same_page, BCC save_same_page); .data_same_page and everything after it, and all later bank 4 code and tables, keep their addresses because the NOP restores the byte. The NOP costs 2 cycles on the cold path (DEC d_ptr+1 runs 0.18 times a pass): about 0.4 cycles a pass.
